limits: Five named optional served-marketing HTTP tests skipped; no required database/browser skips.
Fresh-seed hashes exclude timestamps; populated legacy migration behavior has separate database fixtures.
Browser matrix covers supported action families and bounded edge cases, not every theoretical configuration or timing permutation.
Mobile is emulated WebKit; desktop drag and representative theme/locale coverage are explicitly bounded.
Clipboard content is asserted in Chromium only; strict console collectors vary by spec.
Offline scripted providers prove production tool contracts/orchestration/persistence, not real model comprehension or live provider delivery.
Real paid shipped-model acceptance, production-data preflight, external n8n consumers, release/deployment and Docker architecture acceptance remain separate gates.
Subsequent handoff changes are documentation/evidence only; these counts are not execution on an SSH machine or later functional code.
